text:
rita: Quick announcement: launching a Minute Pacing + Rollover Credit pilot for the Hosted API. Pilot window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-31. Goal: reduce noisy overage spikes for bursty apps and give customers limited rollover of unused free credits.

rita: TL;DR: well meter at 60s granularity for pacing decisions (not per-request billing) and apply up to $500 of unused free credits as a rollover pool per billing period. This is a pilot; metrics will be evaluated after 90 days.

omar: Finance summary: rollout changes invoice CSV (see sample) and adds a new invoice line type "rollover-credit". Rollover credits are non-refundable, cap $500/account/month during pilot, and will be visible in the CSV and console. Retro claims: 30 days.

lee: Engineering notes: were enabling minute-level aggregation in the meterer. API behavior: no change to per-token pricing; this only affects how we apply soft caps and trigger rate-tier moves. New metering header: X-Redwood-Pacing: minute. Old header still accepted.

lee: Sample CSV columns for export v3: 

```
account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,minute_peaks,max_minute_rate,rollover_credit_applied,rollover_credit_amount
```

emily: Support ops please prepare two canned replies: one for startups asking about credits and one for enterprise customers asking about SLA/contract impact. Key Q: "Does this change my SLA or reserved capacity?" -> answer: "No. Dedicated/reserved contracts are unaffected; pilot only applies to Hosted accounts unless explicitly enabled for Dedicated."

finance-bot: Note: Billing API will get a new flag in /v1/invoices?include_rollover=true to return applied rollover items. Backwards compatible if omitted.

omar: Also: customers on legacy free slab tiers will automatically be enrolled in the rollover pilot unless they opt out. Execs: if you need specific customers excluded, contact finance within 48h.

rita: UX: well surface a small meter on the billing page that shows current minute-peak and how much rollover credit remains this cycle. Banner will run 7 days prior to pilot start. Copy draft: "Pilot: minute pacing to reduce spike charges. Up to $500 in unused free credits can roll over per month during the pilot."

emily: Ops question: how do we show this on the invoice PDF?

omar: PDF will show a single line item "Rollover credit applied" with amount. CSV has the detail column.

lee: Developer note: monitoring/alerting teams should expect a new metric redwood.billing.minute_peaks and redwood.billing.rollover_applied. We'll add docs and Grafana panels.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-MPR-2026 and scheduled rollout tasks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-MPR-2026 :white_check_mark:

emily: I'll run a dry-run of support scenarios on Friday and share canned replies in the support playbook.

omar: Action items: 
- @omar: publish pilot rules and FAQ.
- @lee: PR for meterer changes + CSV schema.
- @emily: support playbook + enterprise FAQ.
- @rita: coordinate banner + email to opted-in customers.
- @ops-bot: track pilot metrics and weekly report cadence.

rita: Thanks everyone. If you want to opt a customer out or have legal concerns about rollover language, flag me or @omar. :thumbsup:
